goal: Turn ProofWorker into a bounded revenue-seeking operator that discovers, ranks, prepares and human-confirms small paid technical work, then records real economics.
done_criteria: top opportunities are ranked using job detail and competition signals
at least one human-approved live bid or claim attempt is made
first accepted work is recorded separately from first earned revenue
first paid win is recorded with evidence and economics
three clean paid wins exist before autonomy expands
forbidden_actions: execute untrusted remote code outside an approved sandbox
security-sensitive work involving phishing, credential theft, malware, auth bypass, exfiltration or live-target attacks
next_owner: Run bounded live scan and approve only genuinely qualified first bids
